11 /-!
12 # Noncomputable Set Cardinality
13 
14 We define the cardinality of set `s` as a term `Set.encard s : ℕ∞` and a term `Set.ncard s : ℕ`.
15 The latter takes the junk value of zero if `s` is infinite. Both functions are noncomputable, and
16 are defined in terms of `ENat.card` (which takes a type as its argument); this file can be seen
17 as an API for the same function in the special case where the type is a coercion of a `Set`,
18 allowing for smoother interactions with the `Set` API.
19 
20 `Set.encard` never takes junk values, so is more mathematically natural than `Set.ncard`, even
21 though it takes values in a less convenient type. It is probably the right choice in settings where
22 one is concerned with the cardinalities of sets that may or may not be infinite.
23 
24 `Set.ncard` has a nicer codomain, but when using it, `Set.Finite` hypotheses are normally needed to
25 make sure its values are meaningful.  More generally, `Set.ncard` is intended to be used over the
26 obvious alternative `Finset.card` when finiteness is 'propositional' rather than 'structural'.
27 When working with sets that are finite by virtue of their definition, then `Finset.card` probably
28 makes more sense. One setting where `Set.ncard` works nicely is in a type `α` with `[Finite α]`,
29 where every set is automatically finite. In this setting, we use default arguments and a simple
30 tactic so that finiteness goals are discharged automatically in `Set.ncard` theorems.
31 
32 ## Main Definitions
33 
34 * `Set.encard s` is the cardinality of the set `s` as an extended natural number, with value `⊤` if
35     `s` is infinite.
36 * `Set.ncard s` is the cardinality of the set `s` as a natural number, provided `s` is Finite.
37   If `s` is Infinite, then `Set.ncard s = 0`.
38 * `toFinite_tac` is a tactic that tries to synthesize a `Set.Finite s` argument with
39   `Set.toFinite`. This will work for `s : Set α` where there is a `Finite α` instance.
40 
41 ## Implementation Notes
42 
43 The theorems in this file are very similar to those in `Mathlib/Data/Finset/Card.lean`, but with
44 `Set` operations instead of `Finset`. We first prove all the theorems for `Set.encard`, and then
45 derive most of the `Set.ncard` results as a consequence. Things are done this way to avoid reliance
46 on the `Finset` API for theorems about infinite sets, and to allow for a refactor that removes or
47 modifies `Set.ncard` in the future.
48 
49 Nearly all the theorems for `Set.ncard` require finiteness of one or more of their arguments. We
50 provide this assumption with a default argument of the form `(hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)`,
51 where `toFinite_tac` will find an `s.Finite` term in the cases where `s` is a set in a `Finite`
52 type.
53 
54 Often, where there are two set arguments `s` and `t`, the finiteness of one follows from the other
55 in the context of the theorem, in which case we only include the ones that are needed, and derive
56 the other inside the proof. A few of the theorems, such as `ncard_union_le` do not require
57 finiteness arguments; they are true by coincidence due to junk values.
58 -/

66 /-- The cardinality of a set as a term in `ℕ∞` -/
67 noncomputable def encard (s : Set α) : ℕ∞ := ENat.card s

69 @[simp] theorem encard_univ (α : Type*) :
70     encard (univ : Set α) = ENat.card α := by
71   rw [encard, ENat.card_congr (Equiv.Set.univ α)]

124 theorem encard_union_eq (h : Disjoint s t) : (s ∪ t).encard = s.encard + t.encard := by

129 theorem encard_ne_add_one (a : α) :
130     ({x | x ≠ a}).encard + 1 = ENat.card α := by
131   have : Disjoint {x | x ≠ a} {a} := disjoint_singleton_right.mpr <| by simp
132   replace this := (Set.encard_union_eq this).symm
133   have aux : {x | x ≠ a} ∪ {a} = univ := by ext x; simp [eq_or_ne x a]
134   rwa [encard_singleton, aux, encard_univ] at this

251 lemma Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' (ht : t.Finite) (hst : s ⊆ t) (hts : t.encard ≤ s.encard) :
252     s = t := by
253   rw [← zero_add (a := encard s), ← encard_diff_add_encard_of_subset hst] at hts
254   have hdiff := WithTop.le_of_add_le_add_right (ht.subset hst).encard_lt_top.ne hts
255   rw [nonpos_iff_eq_zero, encard_eq_zero, diff_eq_empty] at hdiff
256   exact hst.antisymm hdiff
257 
258 theorem Finite.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (hs : s.Finite) (hst : s ⊆ t)
259     (hts : t.encard ≤ s.encard) : s = t :=
260   (hs.finite_of_encard_le hts).eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' hst hts

262 theorem Finite.encard_lt_encard (hs : s.Finite) (h : s ⊂ t) : s.encard < t.encard :=
263   (encard_mono h.subset).lt_of_ne fun he ↦ h.ne (hs.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le h.subset he.symm.le)

271 theorem encard_diff_add_encard (s t : Set α) : (s \ t).encard + t.encard = (s ∪ t).encard := by
272   rw [← encard_union_eq disjoint_sdiff_left, diff_union_self]

277 theorem tsub_encard_le_encard_diff (s t : Set α) : s.encard - t.encard ≤ (s \ t).encard := by
278   rw [tsub_le_iff_left, add_comm]; apply encard_le_encard_diff_add_encard

289 theorem encard_insert_le (s : Set α) (x : α) : (insert x s).encard ≤ s.encard + 1 := by
290   rw [← union_singleton, ← encard_singleton x]; apply encard_union_le

293   ENat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| encard_ne_zero_of_mem (mem_insert a s)

295 theorem encard_singleton_inter (s : Set α) (x : α) : ({x} ∩ s).encard ≤ 1 := by
296   grw [← encard_singleton x, inter_subset_left]

298 theorem encard_diff_singleton_add_one (h : a ∈ s) :
299     (s \ {a}).encard + 1 = s.encard := by
300   rw [← encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), insert_diff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem h]

302 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in

304     (s \ {a}).encard = s.encard - 1 := by
305   rw [← encard_diff_singleton_add_one h, ← WithTop.add_right_inj WithTop.one_ne_top,
306     tsub_add_cancel_of_le (self_le_add_left _ _)]

308 theorem encard_tsub_one_le_encard_diff_singleton (s : Set α) (x : α) :
309     s.encard - 1 ≤ (s \ {x}).encard := by
310   rw [← encard_singleton x]; apply tsub_encard_le_encard_diff
311 
312 theorem encard_exchange (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) : (insert a (s \ {b})).encard = s.encard := by
313   rw [encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_diff_singleton_add_one hb]
314   simp_all only [mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff, false_and, not_false_eq_true]
315 
316 theorem encard_exchange' (ha : a ∉ s) (hb : b ∈ s) : (insert a s \ {b}).encard = s.encard := by
317   rw [← insert_diff_singleton_comm (by rintro rfl; exact ha hb), encard_exchange ha hb]
318 
319 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
320 theorem encard_eq_add_one_iff {k : ℕ∞} :
321     s.encard = k + 1 ↔ (∃ a t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s ∧ t.encard = k) := by
322   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, ?_⟩
323   · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by simp [h])
324     refine ⟨a, s \ {a}, fun h ↦ h.2 rfl, by rwa [insert_diff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem], ?_⟩
325     rw [← WithTop.add_right_inj WithTop.one_ne_top, ← h,
326       encard_diff_singleton_add_one ha]
327   rintro ⟨a, t, h, rfl, rfl⟩
328   rw [encard_insert_of_notMem h]
329 
330 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
331 /-- Every set is either empty, infinite, or can have its `encard` reduced by a removal. Intended
332   for well-founded induction on the value of `encard`. -/
333 theorem eq_empty_or_encard_eq_top_or_encard_diff_singleton_lt (s : Set α) :
334     s = ∅ ∨ s.encard = ⊤ ∨ ∃ a ∈ s, (s \ {a}).encard < s.encard := by
335   refine s.eq_empty_or_nonempty.elim Or.inl (Or.inr ∘ fun ⟨a,ha⟩ ↦
336     (s.finite_or_infinite.elim (fun hfin ↦ Or.inr ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩) (Or.inl ∘ Infinite.encard_eq)))
337   rw [← encard_diff_singleton_add_one ha]; nth_rw 1 [← add_zero (encard _)]
338   exact WithTop.add_lt_add_left hfin.diff.encard_lt_top.ne zero_lt_one
339 
340 end InsertErase

345 theorem encard_pair {x y : α} (hne : x ≠ y) : ({x, y} : Set α).encard = 2 := by
346   rw [encard_insert_of_notMem (by simpa), ← one_add_one_eq_two,
347     WithTop.add_right_inj WithTop.one_ne_top, encard_singleton]

349 theorem encard_eq_one : s.encard = 1 ↔ ∃ x, s = {x} := by
350   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ by rw [hx, encard_singleton]⟩
351   obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
352   exact ⟨x, ((finite_singleton x).eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (by simpa) (by simp [h])).symm⟩
353 
354 theorem encard_le_one_iff_eq : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ x, s = {x} := by
355   rw [le_iff_lt_or_eq, lt_iff_not_ge, ENat.one_le_iff_ne_zero, not_not, encard_eq_zero,
356     encard_eq_one]
357 
358 theorem encard_le_one_iff : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ a b, a ∈ s → b ∈ s → a = b := by
359   rw [encard_le_one_iff_eq, or_iff_not_imp_left, ← Ne, ← nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
360   refine ⟨fun h a b has hbs ↦ ?_,
361     fun h ⟨x, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, ((singleton_subset_iff.2 hx).antisymm' (fun y hy ↦ h _ _ hy hx))⟩⟩
362   obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := h ⟨_, has⟩
363   rw [(has : a = x), (hbs : b = x)]
364 
365 theorem encard_le_one_iff_subsingleton : s.encard ≤ 1 ↔ s.Subsingleton := by
366   rw [encard_le_one_iff, Set.Subsingleton]
367   tauto
368 
369 theorem one_lt_encard_iff_nontrivial : 1 < s.encard ↔ s.Nontrivial := by
370   contrapose!; exact encard_le_one_iff_subsingleton
371 
372 theorem one_lt_encard_iff : 1 < s.encard ↔ ∃ a b, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b := by
373   contrapose!; exact encard_le_one_iff
374 
375 theorem exists_ne_of_one_lt_encard (h : 1 < s.encard) (a : α) : ∃ b ∈ s, b ≠ a := by
376   by_contra! h'
377   obtain ⟨b, b', hb, hb', hne⟩ := one_lt_encard_iff.1 h
378   apply hne
379   rw [h' b hb, h' b' hb']
380 
381 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
382 theorem encard_eq_two : s.encard = 2 ↔ ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ s = {x, y} := by
383   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, hne, hs⟩ ↦ by rw [hs, encard_pair hne]⟩
384   obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
385   rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_diff_singleton, encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl),
386     ← one_add_one_eq_two, WithTop.add_right_inj (WithTop.one_ne_top), encard_eq_one] at h
387   obtain ⟨y, h⟩ := h
388   refine ⟨x, y, by rintro rfl; exact (h.symm.subset rfl).2 rfl, ?_⟩
389   rw [← h, insert_diff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]
390 
391 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
392 theorem encard_eq_three {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} :
393     encard s = 3 ↔ ∃ x y z, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ s = {x, y, z} := by
394   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, z, hxy, hyz, hxz, hs⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
395   · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
396     rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_diff_singleton,
397       encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), (by exact rfl : (3 : ℕ∞) = 2 + 1),
398       WithTop.add_right_inj WithTop.one_ne_top, encard_eq_two] at h
399     obtain ⟨y, z, hne, hs⟩ := h
400     refine ⟨x, y, z, ?_, ?_, hne, ?_⟩
401     · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inl rfl)).2 rfl
402     · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr rfl)).2 rfl
403     rw [← hs, insert_diff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]
404   rw [hs, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_singleton] <;> aesop
405 
406 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
407 theorem encard_eq_four {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} :
408     encard s = 4 ↔ ∃ x y z w, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ x ≠ w ∧ y ≠ z ∧ y ≠ w ∧ z ≠ w ∧ s = {x, y, z, w} := by
409   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun ⟨x, y, z, w, hxy, hxz, hxw, hyz, hyw, hzw, hs⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
410   · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nonempty_of_encard_ne_zero (s := s) (by rw [h]; simp)
411     rw [← insert_eq_of_mem hx, ← insert_diff_singleton,
412       encard_insert_of_notMem (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl), (by exact rfl : (4 : ℕ∞) = 3 + 1),
413       WithTop.add_right_inj WithTop.one_ne_top, encard_eq_three] at h
414     obtain ⟨y, z, w, hyz, hyw, hzw, hs⟩ := h
415     refine ⟨x, y, z, w, ?_, ?_, ?_, hyz, hyw, hzw, ?_⟩
416     · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inl rfl)).2 rfl
417     · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))).2 rfl
418     · rintro rfl; exact (hs.symm.subset (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))).2 rfl
419     rw [← hs, insert_diff_singleton, insert_eq_of_mem hx]
420   rw [hs, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem, encard_insert_of_notMem,
421     encard_singleton] <;> grind
422 
423 theorem Nat.encard_range (k : ℕ) : {i | i < k}.encard = k := by
424   convert encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard (Finset.range k) using 1
425   · rw [Finset.coe_range, Iio_def]
426   rw [Finset.card_range]

430 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
431 theorem Finite.eq_insert_of_subset_of_encard_eq_succ (hs : s.Finite) (h : s ⊆ t)
432     (hst : t.encard = s.encard + 1) : ∃ a, t = insert a s := by
433   rw [← encard_diff_add_encard_of_subset h, add_comm, WithTop.add_left_inj hs.encard_lt_top.ne,
434     encard_eq_one] at hst
435   obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hst; use x; rw [← diff_union_of_subset h, hx, singleton_union]
436 
437 theorem exists_subset_encard_eq {k : ℕ∞} (hk : k ≤ s.encard) : ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.encard = k := by
438   induction k using ENat.nat_induction with
439   | zero => exact ⟨∅, empty_subset _, by simp⟩
440   | succ n IH =>
441     obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀s, ht₀⟩ := IH (le_trans (by simp) hk)
442     simp only [Nat.cast_succ] at *
443     have hne : t₀ ≠ s := by
444       rintro rfl; rw [ht₀, ← Nat.cast_one, ← Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_le] at hk; simp at hk
445     obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_of_ssubset (ht₀s.ssubset_of_ne hne)
446     exact ⟨insert x t₀, insert_subset hx.1 ht₀s, by rw [encard_insert_of_notMem hx.2, ht₀]⟩
447   | top => rw [top_le_iff] at hk; exact ⟨s, Subset.rfl, hk⟩
448 
449 theorem exists_superset_subset_encard_eq {k : ℕ∞}
450     (hst : s ⊆ t) (hsk : s.encard ≤ k) (hkt : k ≤ t.encard) :
451     ∃ r, s ⊆ r ∧ r ⊆ t ∧ r.encard = k := by
452   obtain (hs | hs) := eq_or_ne s.encard ⊤
453   · rw [hs, top_le_iff] at hsk; subst hsk; exact ⟨s, Subset.rfl, hst, hs⟩
454   obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := exists_add_of_le hsk
455   obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := exists_add_of_le hkt
456   have hk : k ≤ encard (t \ s) := by
457     rw [← encard_diff_add_encard_of_subset hst, add_comm] at hkt
458     exact WithTop.le_of_add_le_add_right hs hkt
459   obtain ⟨r', hr', rfl⟩ := exists_subset_encard_eq hk
460   refine ⟨s ∪ r', subset_union_left, union_subset hst (hr'.trans diff_subset), ?_⟩
461   rw [encard_union_eq (disjoint_of_subset_right hr' disjoint_sdiff_right)]

465 variable {s : Set α} {t : Set β} {f : α → β}

467 theorem InjOn.encard_image (h : InjOn f s) : (f '' s).encard = s.encard := by
468   rw [encard, ENat.card_image_of_injOn h, encard]
469 
470 theorem encard_congr (e : s ≃ t) : s.encard = t.encard := ENat.card_congr e
471 
472 theorem _root_.Function.Injective.encard_image (hf : f.Injective) (s : Set α) :
473     (f '' s).encard = s.encard :=
474   hf.injOn.encard_image
475 
476 theorem _root_.Function.Injective.encard_range (hf : f.Injective) :
477     ENat.card α ≤ (range f).encard := by
478   rw [← image_univ, hf.encard_image, encard_univ]
479 
480 theorem _root_.Function.Embedding.encard_le (e : s ↪ t) : s.encard ≤ t.encard :=
481   ENat.card_le_card_of_injective e.injective
482 
483 theorem encard_image_le (f : α → β) (s : Set α) : (f '' s).encard ≤ s.encard := by
484   obtain (h | h) := isEmpty_or_nonempty α
485   · rw [s.eq_empty_of_isEmpty]; simp
486   grw [← (f.invFunOn_injOn_image s).encard_image, f.invFunOn_image_image_subset s]
487 
488 theorem Finite.injOn_of_encard_image_eq (hs : s.Finite) (h : (f '' s).encard = s.encard) :
489     InjOn f s := by
490   obtain (h' | hne) := isEmpty_or_nonempty α
491   · simp
492   rw [← (f.invFunOn_injOn_image s).encard_image] at h
493   rw [injOn_iff_invFunOn_image_image_eq_self]
494   exact hs.eq_of_subset_of_encard_le' (f.invFunOn_image_image_subset s) h.symm.le
495 
496 theorem encard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range (hf : f.Injective) (ht : t ⊆ range f) :
497     (f ⁻¹' t).encard = t.encard := by
498   rw [← hf.encard_image, image_preimage_eq_inter_range, inter_eq_self_of_subset_left ht]
499 
500 lemma encard_preimage_of_bijective (hf : f.Bijective) (t : Set β) : (f ⁻¹' t).encard = t.encard :=
501   encard_preimage_of_injective_subset_range hf.injective (by simp [hf.surjective.range_eq])
502 
503 theorem encard_le_encard_of_injOn (hf : MapsTo f s t) (f_inj : InjOn f s) :
504     s.encard ≤ t.encard := by
505   grw [← f_inj.encard_image, hf.image_subset]

507 open Notation in
508 lemma encard_preimage_val_le_encard_left (P Q : Set α) : (P ↓∩ Q).encard ≤ P.encard :=
509   (Function.Embedding.subtype _).encard_le
510 
511 open Notation in
512 lemma encard_preimage_val_le_encard_right (P Q : Set α) : (P ↓∩ Q).encard ≤ Q.encard :=
513   Function.Embedding.encard_le ⟨fun ⟨⟨x, _⟩, hx⟩ ↦ ⟨x, hx⟩, fun _ _ h ↦ by
514     simpa [Subtype.coe_inj] using h⟩
515 
516 set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
517 theorem Finite.exists_injOn_of_encard_le [Nonempty β] {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (hs : s.Finite)
518     (hle : s.encard ≤ t.encard) : ∃ (f : α → β), s ⊆ f ⁻¹' t ∧ InjOn f s := by
519   classical
520   obtain (rfl | h | ⟨a, has, -⟩) := s.eq_empty_or_encard_eq_top_or_encard_diff_singleton_lt
521   · simp
522   · exact (encard_ne_top_iff.mpr hs h).elim
523   obtain ⟨b, hbt⟩ := encard_pos.1 ((encard_pos.2 ⟨_, has⟩).trans_le hle)
524   have hle' : (s \ {a}).encard ≤ (t \ {b}).encard := by
525     rwa [← WithTop.add_le_add_iff_right WithTop.one_ne_top,
526     encard_diff_singleton_add_one has, encard_diff_singleton_add_one hbt]
527   obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀s, hinj⟩ := exists_injOn_of_encard_le hs.diff hle'
528   simp only [preimage_diff, subset_def, mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff, mem_preimage, and_imp] at hf₀s
529   use Function.update f₀ a b
530   rw [← insert_eq_of_mem has, ← insert_diff_singleton, injOn_insert (fun h ↦ h.2 rfl)]
531   simp only [mem_diff, mem_singleton_iff, insert_diff_singleton, subset_def,
532     mem_insert_iff, mem_preimage, Function.update_apply, forall_eq_or_imp, ite_true, and_imp,
533     mem_image, ite_eq_left_iff, not_exists, not_and, not_forall, exists_prop, and_iff_right hbt]
534   refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun x hxs hxa ↦ ⟨hxa, (hf₀s x hxs hxa).2⟩⟩
535   · rintro x hx; split_ifs with h
536     · assumption
537     · exact (hf₀s x hx h).1
538   exact InjOn.congr hinj (fun x ⟨_, hxa⟩ ↦ by rwa [Function.update_of_ne])
539 termination_by encard s
540 
541 theorem Finite.exists_bijOn_of_encard_eq [Nonempty β] (hs : s.Finite) (h : s.encard = t.encard) :
542     ∃ (f : α → β), BijOn f s t := by
543   obtain ⟨f, hf, hinj⟩ := hs.exists_injOn_of_encard_le h.le; use f
544   convert hinj.bijOn_image
545   rw [(hs.image f).eq_of_subset_of_encard_le (image_subset_iff.mpr hf)
546     (h.symm.trans hinj.encard_image.symm).le]
547 
548 /-- A version of the pigeonhole principle for `Set`s rather than `Finset`s.
549 
550 See also `Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to` and
551 `Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to`. -/
552 lemma exists_ne_map_eq_of_encard_lt_of_maps_to (hc : t.encard < s.encard) (hf : MapsTo f s t) :
553     ∃ᵉ (a₁ ∈ s) (a₂ ∈ s), a₁ ≠ a₂ ∧ f a₁ = f a₂ := by
554   contrapose! hc
555   suffices Function.Injective (hf.restrict f) by
556     let f' : s ↪ t := ⟨hf.restrict, this⟩
557     exact f'.encard_le
558   simpa only [hf.restrict_inj, not_imp_not] using hc
559 
560 end Function
561 
562 section ncard
563 
564 open Nat
565 
566 /-- A tactic (for use in default params) that applies `Set.toFinite` to synthesize a `Set.Finite`
567   term. -/
568 syntax "toFinite_tac" : tactic
569 
570 macro_rules
571   | `(tactic| toFinite_tac) => `(tactic| apply Set.toFinite)
572 
573 /-- A tactic useful for transferring proofs for `encard` to their corresponding `card` statements -/
574 syntax "to_encard_tac" : tactic
575 
576 macro_rules
577   | `(tactic| to_encard_tac) => `(tactic|
578       simp only [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), ← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one])
579 
580 
581 /-- The cardinality of `s : Set α` . Has the junk value `0` if `s` is infinite -/
582 noncomputable def ncard (s : Set α) : ℕ := ENat.toNat s.encard
583 
584 theorem ncard_def (s : Set α) : s.ncard = ENat.toNat s.encard := rfl
585 
586 theorem Finite.cast_ncard_eq (hs : s.Finite) : s.ncard = s.encard := by
587   rwa [ncard, ENat.coe_toNat_eq_self, ne_eq, encard_eq_top_iff, Set.Infinite, not_not]
588 
589 lemma ncard_le_encard (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ s.encard := ENat.coe_toNat_le_self _
590 
591 @[simp] theorem _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq (s : Set α) : Nat.card s = s.ncard := rfl
592 
593 theorem ncard_eq_toFinset_card (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
594     s.ncard = hs.toFinset.card := by
595   rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, @Nat.card_eq_fintype_card _ hs.fintype,
596     @Finite.card_toFinset _ _ hs.fintype hs]
597 
598 theorem ncard_eq_toFinset_card' (s : Set α) [Fintype s] :
599     s.ncard = s.toFinset.card := by
600   simp [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
601 
602 lemma cast_ncard {s : Set α} (hs : s.Finite) :
603     (s.ncard : Cardinal) = Cardinal.mk s := @Nat.cast_card _ hs
604 
605 theorem encard_le_coe_iff_finite_ncard_le {k : ℕ} : s.encard ≤ k ↔ s.Finite ∧ s.ncard ≤ k := by
606   rw [encard_le_coe_iff, and_congr_right_iff]
607   exact fun hfin ↦ ⟨fun ⟨n₀, hn₀, hle⟩ ↦ by rwa [ncard_def, hn₀, ENat.toNat_coe],
608     fun h ↦ ⟨s.ncard, by rw [hfin.cast_ncard_eq], h⟩⟩
609 
610 theorem Infinite.ncard (hs : s.Infinite) : s.ncard = 0 := by
611   rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq, @Nat.card_eq_zero_of_infinite _ hs.to_subtype]
612 
613 @[gcongr]
614 theorem ncard_le_ncard (hst : s ⊆ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
615     s.ncard ≤ t.ncard := by
616   rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), ht.cast_ncard_eq, (ht.subset hst).cast_ncard_eq]
617   exact encard_mono hst
618 
619 theorem ncard_mono [Finite α] : @Monotone (Set α) _ _ _ ncard := fun _ _ ↦ ncard_le_ncard
620 
621 @[simp] theorem ncard_eq_zero (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
622     s.ncard = 0 ↔ s = ∅ := by
623   rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), hs.cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_zero, encard_eq_zero]
624 
625 @[simp, norm_cast] theorem ncard_coe_finset (s : Finset α) : (s : Set α).ncard = s.card := by
626   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _, Finset.finite_toSet_toFinset]
627 
628 @[simp] theorem ncard_univ (α : Type*) : (univ : Set α).ncard = Nat.card α := Nat.card_univ
629 
630 theorem ncard_le_card [Finite α] (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ Nat.card α :=
631   ncard_univ α ▸ ncard_le_ncard s.subset_univ
632 
633 @[simp] theorem ncard_empty (α : Type*) : (∅ : Set α).ncard = 0 := by
634   rw [ncard_eq_zero]
635 
636 theorem ncard_pos (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : 0 < s.ncard ↔ s.Nonempty := by
637   rw [pos_iff_ne_zero, Ne, ncard_eq_zero hs, nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
638 
639 protected alias ⟨_, Nonempty.ncard_pos⟩ := ncard_pos
640 
641 theorem ncard_ne_zero_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : s.ncard ≠ 0 :=
642   ((ncard_pos hs).mpr ⟨a, h⟩).ne.symm
643 
644 theorem finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (hs : s.ncard ≠ 0) : s.Finite :=
645   s.finite_or_infinite.elim id fun h ↦ (hs h.ncard).elim
646 
647 theorem finite_of_ncard_pos (hs : 0 < s.ncard) : s.Finite :=
648   finite_of_ncard_ne_zero hs.ne.symm
649 
650 theorem nonempty_of_ncard_ne_zero (hs : s.ncard ≠ 0) : s.Nonempty := by
651   rw [nonempty_iff_ne_empty]; rintro rfl; simp at hs
652 
653 @[simp] theorem ncard_singleton (a : α) : ({a} : Set α).ncard = 1 := by
654   simp [ncard]
655 
656 theorem ncard_singleton_inter (a : α) (s : Set α) : ({a} ∩ s).ncard ≤ 1 := by
657   rw [← Nat.cast_le (α := ℕ∞), (toFinite _).cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_one]
658   apply encard_singleton_inter
659 
660 @[simp]
661 theorem ncard_prod {s : Set α} {t : Set β} : (s ×ˢ t).ncard = s.ncard * t.ncard := by
662   simp [ncard, ENat.toNat_mul]
663 
664 @[simp]
665 theorem ncard_powerset (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
666     (𝒫 s).ncard = 2 ^ s.ncard := by
667   have h := Cardinal.mk_powerset s
668   rw [← cast_ncard hs.powerset, ← cast_ncard hs] at h
669   norm_cast at h
670 
671 section InsertErase
672 
673 @[simp] theorem ncard_insert_of_notMem {a : α} (h : a ∉ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
674     (insert a s).ncard = s.ncard + 1 := by
675   rw [← Nat.cast_inj (R := ℕ∞), (hs.insert a).cast_ncard_eq, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one,
676     hs.cast_ncard_eq, encard_insert_of_notMem h]
677 
678 theorem ncard_insert_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) : ncard (insert a s) = s.ncard := by
679   rw [insert_eq_of_mem h]
680 
681 theorem ncard_insert_le (a : α) (s : Set α) : (insert a s).ncard ≤ s.ncard + 1 := by
682   obtain hs | hs := s.finite_or_infinite
683   · to_encard_tac; rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.insert _).cast_ncard_eq]; apply encard_insert_le
684   rw [(hs.mono (subset_insert a s)).ncard]
685   exact Nat.zero_le _
686 
687 theorem one_le_ncard_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
688     1 ≤ (insert a s).ncard :=
689   Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr <| ncard_ne_zero_of_mem (mem_insert a s) (by simp [hs])
690 
691 theorem ncard_insert_eq_ite {a : α} [Decidable (a ∈ s)] (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
692     ncard (insert a s) = if a ∈ s then s.ncard else s.ncard + 1 := by
693   by_cases h : a ∈ s
694   · rw [ncard_insert_of_mem h, if_pos h]
695   · rw [ncard_insert_of_notMem h hs, if_neg h]
696 
697 theorem ncard_le_ncard_insert (a : α) (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ (insert a s).ncard := by
698   classical
699   refine
700     s.finite_or_infinite.elim (fun h ↦ ?_) (fun h ↦ by (rw [h.ncard]; exact Nat.zero_le _))
701   rw [ncard_insert_eq_ite h]; split_ifs <;> simp
702 
703 theorem ncard_pair {a b : α} (h : a ≠ b) : ({a, b} : Set α).ncard = 2 := by
704   simp [h]
705 
706 -- removing `@[simp]` because the LHS is not in simp normal form
707 theorem ncard_diff_singleton_add_one {a : α} (h : a ∈ s)
708     (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s \ {a}).ncard + 1 = s.ncard := by
709   to_encard_tac
710   rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, hs.diff.cast_ncard_eq, encard_diff_singleton_add_one h]
711 
712 @[simp] theorem ncard_diff_singleton_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) :
713     (s \ {a}).ncard = s.ncard - 1 := by
714   rcases s.infinite_or_finite with hs | hs
715   · simp_all [ncard, Infinite.diff hs (finite_singleton a)]
716   · exact eq_tsub_of_add_eq (ncard_diff_singleton_add_one h hs)
717 
718 theorem ncard_diff_singleton_lt_of_mem {a : α} (h : a ∈ s) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
719     (s \ {a}).ncard < s.ncard := by
720   rw [← ncard_diff_singleton_add_one h hs]; apply lt_add_one
721 
722 theorem ncard_diff_singleton_le (s : Set α) (a : α) : (s \ {a}).ncard ≤ s.ncard := by
723   obtain hs | hs := s.finite_or_infinite
724   · apply ncard_le_ncard diff_subset hs
725   convert zero_le (α := ℕ) _
726   exact (hs.diff (by simp : Set.Finite {a})).ncard
727 
728 theorem pred_ncard_le_ncard_diff_singleton (s : Set α) (a : α) : s.ncard - 1 ≤ (s \ {a}).ncard := by
729   by_cases h : a ∈ s
730   · rw [ncard_diff_singleton_of_mem h]
731   rw [diff_singleton_eq_self h]
732   apply Nat.pred_le
733

835 theorem ncard_eq_of_bijective {n : ℕ} (f : ∀ i, i < n → α)
836     (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ i, ∃ h : i < n, f i h = a) (hf' : ∀ (i) (h : i < n), f i h ∈ s)
837     (f_inj : ∀ (i j) (hi : i < n) (hj : j < n), f i hi = f j hj → i = j) : s.ncard = n := by
838   let f' : Fin n → α := fun i ↦ f i.val i.is_lt
839   suffices himage : s = f' '' Set.univ by
840     rw [← Fintype.card_fin n, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Set.ncard_univ, himage]
841     exact InjOn.ncard_image <| fun i _hi j _hj h ↦ Fin.ext <| f_inj i.val j.val i.is_lt j.is_lt h
842   ext x
843   simp only [image_univ, mem_range]
844   refine ⟨fun hx ↦ ?_, fun ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, hx⟩ ↦ hx ▸ hf' i hi⟩
845   obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hf x hx
846   use ⟨i, hi⟩

848 theorem ncard_congr {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (h₁ : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
849     (h₂ : ∀ a b ha hb, f a ha = f b hb → a = b) (h₃ : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, f a ha = b) :
850     s.ncard = t.ncard := by
851   set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, h₁ _ _⟩
852   have hbij : f'.Bijective := by
853     constructor
854     · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
855       simp only [f', Subtype.mk.injEq] at hxy ⊢
856       exact h₂ _ _ hx hy hxy
857     rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
858     obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := h₃ y hy
859     simp only [Subtype.exists]
860     exact ⟨_, ha, rfl⟩
861   simp_rw [← _root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
862   exact Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f' hbij)
863 
864 theorem ncard_congr' {S : Set α} {T : Set β} (f : S ≃ T) : Set.ncard S = Set.ncard T :=

867 theorem ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn {t : Set β} (f : α → β) (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) (f_inj : InjOn f s)

879 /-- A version of the pigeonhole principle for `Set`s rather than `Finset`s.
880 
881 See also `Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to` and
882 `Set.exists_ne_map_eq_of_encard_lt_of_maps_to`. -/
883 theorem exists_ne_map_eq_of_ncard_lt_of_maps_to {t : Set β} (hc : t.ncard < s.ncard) {f : α → β}
884     (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
885     ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ y ∈ s, x ≠ y ∧ f x = f y := by
886   by_contra h'
887   simp only [Ne, not_exists, not_and, not_imp_not] at h'
888   exact (ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn f hf h' ht).not_gt hc
889 
890 theorem le_ncard_of_inj_on_range {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → α) (hf : ∀ i < n, f i ∈ s)
891     (f_inj : ∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, f i = f j → i = j) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
892     n ≤ s.ncard := by
893   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs]
894   apply Finset.le_card_of_inj_on_range <;> simpa

896 theorem surj_on_of_inj_on_of_ncard_le {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
897     (hinj : ∀ a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂, f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂ → a₁ = a₂) (hst : t.ncard ≤ s.ncard)
898     (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
899     ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, b = f a ha := by
900   intro b hb
901   set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, hf _ _⟩
902   have finj : f'.Injective := by
903     rintro ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩ hxy
904     simp only [f', Subtype.mk.injEq] at hxy ⊢
905     apply hinj _ _ hx hy hxy
906   have hft := ht.fintype
907   have hft' := Fintype.ofInjective f' finj
908   set f'' : ∀ a, a ∈ s.toFinset → β := fun a h ↦ f a (by simpa using h)
909   convert @Finset.surj_on_of_inj_on_of_card_le _ _ _ t.toFinset f'' _ _ _ _ (by simpa) using 1
910   · simp [f'']
911   · simp [f'', hf]
912   · intro a₁ a₂ ha₁ ha₂ h
913     rw [mem_toFinset] at ha₁ ha₂
914     exact hinj _ _ ha₁ ha₂ h
915   rwa [← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
916 
917 theorem inj_on_of_surj_on_of_ncard_le {t : Set β} (f : ∀ a ∈ s, β) (hf : ∀ a ha, f a ha ∈ t)
918     (hsurj : ∀ b ∈ t, ∃ a ha, f a ha = b) (hst : s.ncard ≤ t.ncard) ⦃a₁⦄ (ha₁ : a₁ ∈ s) ⦃a₂⦄
919     (ha₂ : a₂ ∈ s) (ha₁a₂ : f a₁ ha₁ = f a₂ ha₂) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
920     a₁ = a₂ := by
921   classical
922   set f' : s → t := fun x ↦ ⟨f x.1 x.2, hf _ _⟩
923   have hsurj : f'.Surjective := by
924     rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
925     obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hsurj y hy
926     simp only [Subtype.exists]
927     exact ⟨_, ha, rfl⟩
928   haveI := hs.fintype
929   haveI := Fintype.ofSurjective _ hsurj
930   set f'' : ∀ a, a ∈ s.toFinset → β := fun a h ↦ f a (by simpa using h)
931   exact
932     @Finset.inj_on_of_surj_on_of_card_le _ _ _ t.toFinset f''
933       (fun a ha ↦ by { rw [mem_toFinset] at ha ⊢; exact hf a ha }) (by simpa)
934       (by { rwa [← ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← ncard_eq_toFinset_card'] }) a₁
935       (by simpa) a₂ (by simpa) (by simpa)
936

945 theorem ncard_union_add_ncard_inter (s t : Set α) (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac)
946     (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∪ t).ncard + (s ∩ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard := by
947   to_encard_tac; rw [hs.cast_ncard_eq, ht.cast_ncard_eq, (hs.union ht).cast_ncard_eq,

951     (ht : t.Finite := by toFinite_tac) : (s ∩ t).ncard + (s ∪ t).ncard = s.ncard + t.ncard := by
952   rw [add_comm, ncard_union_add_ncard_inter _ _ hs ht]

954 theorem ncard_union_le (s t : Set α) : (s ∪ t).ncard ≤ s.ncard + t.ncard := by
955   obtain (h | h) := (s ∪ t).finite_or_infinite
956   · to_encard_tac
957     rw [h.cast_ncard_eq, (h.subset subset_union_left).cast_ncard_eq,
958       (h.subset subset_union_right).cast_ncard_eq]
959     apply encard_union_le
960   rw [h.ncard]
961   apply zero_le

1061 theorem nonempty_inter_of_lt_ncard_add_ncard [Finite α]
1062     (h : Nat.card α < s.ncard + t.ncard) : (s ∩ t).Nonempty := by
1063   rw [← ncard_union_add_ncard_inter s t] at h
1064   replace h := (s ∪ t).ncard_le_card.trans_lt h
1065   rwa [lt_add_iff_pos_right, ncard_pos] at h
1066 
1067 theorem nonempty_inter_of_le_ncard_add_ncard [Finite α]
1068     (h' : Nat.card α ≤ s.ncard + t.ncard) (h : s ∪ t ≠ univ) :
1069     (s ∩ t).Nonempty := by
1070   rw [← ncard_union_add_ncard_inter s t] at h'
1071   replace h := (ncard_lt_card h).trans_le h'
1072   rwa [lt_add_iff_pos_right, ncard_pos] at h
1073 
1074 theorem union_ne_univ_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
1075     (h : s.ncard + t.ncard < Nat.card α) : s ∪ t ≠ univ := by
1076   contrapose! h
1077   rw [← ncard_univ, ← h]
1078   exact ncard_union_le s t
1079 
1080 theorem nonempty_inter_compl_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt
1081     (h : s.ncard + t.ncard < Nat.card α) : (sᶜ ∩ tᶜ).Nonempty := by
1082   rw [← compl_union, nonempty_compl]
1083   exact union_ne_univ_of_ncard_add_ncard_lt h
1084 
1085 end Lattice

1087 /-- Given a subset `s` of a set `t`, of sizes at most and at least `n` respectively, there exists a
1088 set `u` of size `n` which is both a superset of `s` and a subset of `t`. -/
1089 lemma exists_subsuperset_card_eq {n : ℕ} (hst : s ⊆ t) (hsn : s.ncard ≤ n) (hnt : n ≤ t.ncard) :
1090     ∃ u, s ⊆ u ∧ u ⊆ t ∧ u.ncard = n := by
1091   obtain ht | ht := t.infinite_or_finite
1092   · rw [ht.ncard, Nat.le_zero, ← ht.ncard] at hnt
1093     exact ⟨t, hst, Subset.rfl, hnt.symm⟩
1094   lift s to Finset α using ht.subset hst
1095   lift t to Finset α using ht
1096   obtain ⟨u, hsu, hut, hu⟩ := Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq (mod_cast hst) (by simpa using hsn)
1097     (mod_cast hnt)
1098   exact ⟨u, mod_cast hsu, mod_cast hut, mod_cast hu⟩
1099 
1100 /-- We can shrink a set to any smaller size. -/
1101 lemma exists_subset_card_eq {n : ℕ} (hns : n ≤ s.ncard) : ∃ t ⊆ s, t.ncard = n := by
1102   simpa using exists_subsuperset_card_eq s.empty_subset (by simp) hns
1103 
1104 theorem Infinite.exists_subset_ncard_eq {s : Set α} (hs : s.Infinite) (k : ℕ) :
1105     ∃ t, t ⊆ s ∧ t.Finite ∧ t.ncard = k := by
1106   have := hs.to_subtype
1107   obtain ⟨t', -, rfl⟩ := @Infinite.exists_subset_card_eq s univ infinite_univ k
1108   refine ⟨Subtype.val '' (t' : Set s), by simp, Finite.image _ (by simp), ?_⟩
1109   rw [ncard_image_of_injective _ Subtype.coe_injective]
1110   simp
1111 
1112 theorem Infinite.exists_superset_ncard_eq {s t : Set α} (ht : t.Infinite) (hst : s ⊆ t)
1113     (hs : s.Finite) {k : ℕ} (hsk : s.ncard ≤ k) : ∃ s', s ⊆ s' ∧ s' ⊆ t ∧ s'.ncard = k := by
1114   obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hs₁fin, hs₁card⟩ := (ht.diff hs).exists_subset_ncard_eq (k - s.ncard)
1115   refine ⟨s ∪ s₁, subset_union_left, union_subset hst (hs₁.trans diff_subset), ?_⟩
1116   rwa [ncard_union_eq (disjoint_of_subset_right hs₁ disjoint_sdiff_right) hs hs₁fin, hs₁card,
1117     add_tsub_cancel_of_le]
1118 
1119 theorem exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_ncard {n : ℕ} (hst : 2 * n < (s ∪ t).ncard) :
1120     ∃ r : Set α, n < r.ncard ∧ (r ⊆ s ∨ r ⊆ t) := by
1121   classical
1122   have hu := finite_of_ncard_ne_zero ((Nat.zero_le _).trans_lt hst).ne.symm
1123   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hu,
1124     Finite.toFinset_union (hu.subset subset_union_left)
1125       (hu.subset subset_union_right)] at hst
1126   obtain ⟨r', hnr', hr'⟩ := Finset.exists_subset_or_subset_of_two_mul_lt_card hst
1127   exact ⟨r', by simpa, by simpa using hr'⟩
1128 
1129 lemma _root_.Finset.exists_not_mem_of_card_lt_enatCard {s : Finset α} (hs : s.card < ENat.card α) :
1130     ∃ a, a ∉ s := by
1131   contrapose! hs
1132   simp [← Set.encard_coe_eq_coe_finsetCard, Set.eq_univ_of_forall (α := α) (s := s) hs]

1136 @[simp] theorem ncard_eq_one : s.ncard = 1 ↔ ∃ a, s = {a} := by
1137   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, by rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩; rw [ncard_singleton]⟩
1138   have hft := (finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (ne_zero_of_eq_one h)).fintype
1139   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card', @Finset.card_eq_one _ (toFinset s)] at h
1140   refine h.imp fun a ha ↦ ?_
1141   simp_rw [Set.ext_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
1142   simp only [Finset.ext_iff, mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
1143   exact ha
1144 
1145 theorem exists_eq_insert_iff_ncard (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1146     (∃ a ∉ s, insert a s = t) ↔ s ⊆ t ∧ s.ncard + 1 = t.ncard := by
1147   classical
1148   rcases t.finite_or_infinite with ht | ht
1149   · rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ ht,
1150       ← @Finite.toFinset_subset_toFinset _ _ _ hs ht, ← Finset.exists_eq_insert_iff]
1151     convert Iff.rfl using 2; simp only [Finite.mem_toFinset]
1152     ext x
1153     simp [Finset.ext_iff, Set.ext_iff]
1154   simp only [ht.ncard, add_eq_zero, and_false, iff_false, not_exists, not_and,
1155     reduceCtorEq]
1156   rintro x - rfl
1157   exact ht (hs.insert x)
1158 
1159 theorem ncard_le_one (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1160     s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, a = b := by
1161   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.card_le_one, Finite.mem_toFinset]
1162 
1163 @[simp] theorem ncard_le_one_iff_subsingleton [Finite s] :
1164     s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ s.Subsingleton :=
1165   ncard_le_one <| inferInstanceAs (Finite s)
1166 
1167 theorem ncard_le_one_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1168     s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ ∀ {a b}, a ∈ s → b ∈ s → a = b := by
1169   rw [ncard_le_one hs]
1170   tauto
1171 
1172 theorem ncard_le_one_iff_eq (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1173     s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ s = ∅ ∨ ∃ a, s = {a} := by
1174   obtain rfl | ⟨x, hx⟩ := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
1175   · exact iff_of_true (by simp) (Or.inl rfl)
1176   rw [ncard_le_one_iff hs]
1177   refine ⟨fun h ↦ Or.inr ⟨x, (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hx).antisymm' fun y hy ↦ h hy hx⟩, ?_⟩
1178   grind
1179 
1180 theorem ncard_le_one_iff_subset_singleton [Nonempty α]
1181     (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1182     s.ncard ≤ 1 ↔ ∃ x : α, s ⊆ {x} := by
1183   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.card_le_one_iff_subset_singleton,
1184     Finite.toFinset_subset, Finset.coe_singleton]
1185 
1186 /-- A `Set` of a subsingleton type has cardinality at most one. -/
1187 theorem ncard_le_one_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton α] (s : Set α) : s.ncard ≤ 1 := by
1188   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card]
1189   exact Finset.card_le_one_of_subsingleton _
1190 
1191 theorem one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial [Finite s] :
1192     1 < s.ncard ↔ s.Nontrivial := by
1193   rw [← not_subsingleton_iff, ← ncard_le_one_iff_subsingleton, not_le]
1194 
1195 theorem one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial_and_finite :
1196     1 < s.ncard ↔ s.Nontrivial ∧ s.Finite := by
1197   refine ⟨fun hs ↦ ?_, fun ⟨hs_nontrivial, hs_finite⟩ ↦ ?_⟩
1198   · have := finite_of_ncard_pos (Nat.zero_lt_of_lt hs)
1199     rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff] at this
1200     exact ⟨one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial.mp hs, this⟩
1201   · rw [← Set.finite_coe_iff] at hs_finite
1202     rwa [one_lt_ncard_iff_nontrivial]
1203 
1204 theorem one_lt_ncard (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1205     1 < s.ncard ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ s, a ≠ b := by
1206   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.one_lt_card, Finite.mem_toFinset]
1207 
1208 theorem one_lt_ncard_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1209     1 < s.ncard ↔ ∃ a b, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b := by
1210   rw [one_lt_ncard hs]
1211   simp only [exists_and_left]

1213 lemma one_lt_ncard_of_nonempty_of_even (hs : Set.Finite s) (hn : Set.Nonempty s := by toFinite_tac)
1214     (he : Even (s.ncard)) : 1 < s.ncard := by
1215   rw [← Set.ncard_pos hs] at hn
1216   have : s.ncard ≠ 1 := fun h ↦ by simp [h] at he
1217   lia

1219 theorem two_lt_ncard_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1220     2 < s.ncard ↔ ∃ a b c, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ c ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c := by
1221   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.two_lt_card_iff, Finite.mem_toFinset]
1222 
1223 theorem two_lt_ncard (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1224     2 < s.ncard ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ s, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c := by
1225   simp only [two_lt_ncard_iff hs, exists_and_left]

1227 theorem three_lt_ncard_iff (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1228     3 < s.ncard ↔
1229     ∃ a b c d, a ∈ s ∧ b ∈ s ∧ c ∈ s ∧ d ∈ s ∧ a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d := by
1230   simp_rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hs, Finset.three_lt_card_iff, Finite.mem_toFinset]
1231 
1232 theorem three_lt_ncard (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1233     3 < s.ncard ↔
1234     ∃ a ∈ s, ∃ b ∈ s, ∃ c ∈ s, ∃ d ∈ s, a ≠ b ∧ a ≠ c ∧ a ≠ d ∧ b ≠ c ∧ b ≠ d ∧ c ≠ d := by
1235   simp only [three_lt_ncard_iff hs, exists_and_left]

1237 theorem exists_ne_of_one_lt_ncard (hs : 1 < s.ncard) (a : α) : ∃ b, b ∈ s ∧ b ≠ a := by
1238   have hsf := finite_of_ncard_ne_zero (zero_lt_one.trans hs).ne.symm
1239   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hsf] at hs
1240   simpa only [Finite.mem_toFinset] using Finset.exists_mem_ne hs a

1242 theorem eq_insert_of_ncard_eq_succ {n : ℕ} (h : s.ncard = n + 1) :
1243     ∃ a t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s ∧ t.ncard = n := by
1244   classical
1245   have hsf := finite_of_ncard_pos (n.zero_lt_succ.trans_eq h.symm)
1246   rw [ncard_eq_toFinset_card _ hsf, Finset.card_eq_succ] at h
1247   obtain ⟨a, t, hat, hts, rfl⟩ := h
1248   simp only [Finset.ext_iff, Finset.mem_insert, Finite.mem_toFinset] at hts
1249   refine ⟨a, t, hat, ?_, ?_⟩
1250   · simp [Set.ext_iff, hts]
1251   · simp
1252 
1253 theorem ncard_eq_succ {n : ℕ} (hs : s.Finite := by toFinite_tac) :
1254     s.ncard = n + 1 ↔ ∃ a t, a ∉ t ∧ insert a t = s ∧ t.ncard = n := by
1255   refine ⟨eq_insert_of_ncard_eq_succ, ?_⟩
1256   rintro ⟨a, t, hat, h, rfl⟩
1257   rw [← h, ncard_insert_of_notMem hat (hs.subset ((subset_insert a t).trans_eq h))]
1258 
1259 theorem ncard_eq_two : s.ncard = 2 ↔ ∃ x y, x ≠ y ∧ s = {x, y} := by
1260   rw [← encard_eq_two, ncard_def]
1261   simp
1262 
1263 theorem ncard_eq_three : s.ncard = 3 ↔ ∃ x y z, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ y ≠ z ∧ s = {x, y, z} := by
1264   rw [← encard_eq_three, ncard_def]
1265   simp

1267 theorem ncard_eq_four : s.ncard = 4 ↔
1268     ∃ x y z w, x ≠ y ∧ x ≠ z ∧ x ≠ w ∧ y ≠ z ∧ y ≠ w ∧ z ≠ w ∧ s = {x, y, z, w} := by
1269   rw [← encard_eq_four, ncard_def]

1272 theorem ncard_sumEquiv_symm_apply {α : Type*} (s : Set α) :
1273     (Set.sumEquiv.symm (s, s)).ncard = s.ncard + s.ncard := by
1274   by_cases hs : s.Finite
1275   · simp [(ncard_union_eq_iff (.image _ hs) (.image _ hs)).2 disjoint_image_inl_image_inr,
1276       ncard_image_of_injective _ Sum.inl_injective, ncard_image_of_injective _ Sum.inr_injective]
1277   · simp [(infinite_union.2 <| .inl <| .image Sum.inl_injective.injOn hs).ncard, Infinite.ncard hs]
1278 
1279 end ncard

1282 /-- A surjective function `f : α → β` decreases cardinality by at most one if and only if
1283 there is at most a collision between a unique pair of elements. -/
1284 theorem Function.Surjective.card_le_card_add_one_iff
1285     {α β : Type*} [Finite α] {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
1286     Nat.card α ≤ Nat.card β + 1 ↔ ∀ a b c d,
1287       f a = f b → f c = f d → a ≠ b → c ≠ d → {a, b} = ({c, d} : Set α) := by
1288   rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty α
1289   · simp
1290   -- pick an inverse `g` to `f`
1291   let g := Function.surjInv hf
1292   -- the "decreases cardinality by at most one condition" becomes "`g` misses at most one element"
1293   rw [← Set.ncard_range_of_injective (Function.injective_surjInv hf),
1294     ← Set.ncard_add_ncard_compl (Set.range g), add_le_add_iff_left]
1295   replace hf : ∀ b, f (g b) = b := Function.surjInv_eq hf
1296   refine ⟨fun h ↦ ?_, fun h ↦ ?_⟩
1297   · rw [Set.ncard_le_one_iff_subset_singleton] at h
1298     -- if `g` misses at most one element, let `x` be this element
1299     obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h
1300     simp only [Set.subset_def, Set.mem_compl_iff] at hx
1301     -- we show that the only possible collision is between `x` and `g (f x)`
1302     suffices ∀ a b : α, f a = f b → a ≠ b → a = x ∨ a = g (f x) by grind
1303     intro a b
1304     by_cases ha : a ∈ Set.range g <;> by_cases hb : b ∈ Set.range g <;> grind
1305   · -- we must show that any two elements `a` and `b` missed by `g` are equal
1306     rw [Set.ncard_le_one]
1307     simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_range, not_exists, ← ne_eq]
1308     intro a ha b hb
1309     -- there is a collision between `a` and `g (f a)`, and between `b` and `g (f b)`
1310     simpa [(ha (f b)).symm] using congrArg (a ∈ ·) (h a (g (f a)) b (g (f b))
1311       (hf (f a)).symm (hf (f b)).symm (ha (f a)).symm (hb (f b)).symm)
1312 
1313 /-- A function `f : α → β` decreases cardinality by at most one if and only if
1314 there is at most a collision between a unique pair of elements. -/
1315 theorem Set.ncard_le_ncard_image_add_one_iff {α β : Type*} (s : Set α) [Finite s] (f : α → β) :
1316     s.ncard ≤ (f '' s).ncard + 1 ↔ ∀ a ∈ s, ∀ b ∈ s, ∀ c ∈ s, ∀ d ∈ s,
1317       f a = f b → f c = f d → a ≠ b → c ≠ d → {a, b} = ({c, d} : Set α) := by
1318   simpa [Subtype.ext_iff, ← (Set.image_injective.mpr Subtype.val_injective).eq_iff,
1319      Set.image_insert_eq, Set.image_singleton] using
1320       (Set.surjective_mapsTo_image_restrict f s).card_le_card_add_one_iff
